product.olivetti-netstrada-1000.summary: The entry NetStrada that Olivetti offered to small and medium-sized businesses.
product.olivetti-netstrada-1000.history: In March 1997, Olivetti presented the NetStrada 1000 for small and medium-sized businesses. Computerwoche reported a starting price of DM 5,400.
product.olivetti-netstrada-1000.architec: The 200 MHz configuration is independently identified. Sun documented the Pentium Pro 200 M1 and its RAID variant for Solaris 2.6.
product.olivetti-netstrada-1000.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-netstrada-1000.limitati: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-netstrada-1000.computer: Computerwoche, Olivetti startet mit neuer Führung ins Jahr 1997, 28 March 1997
